description: Unpin a pinned message from a channel or thread. To add a pin use discord_create_pin, and to list all current pinned messages use discord_list_pins. Returns a confirmation object with the unpinned message and channel IDs. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Pin Messages. Changes or removes existing Discord data without an approval prompt.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread that holds the message

reason.description: Audit log reason sent in the X-Audit-Log-Reason header (up to 512 characters)

name: discord_delete_pin

channel_id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

message_id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
